messages:
maria (marketing): Quick sync — launch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URLs, a small benchmark blurb for the post, and confirmation on canary timing. Also want a single-slide screenshot of the dashboard for the blog. Who can own each? :eyes:

dev (eng): Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/910. Includes router fallback note.

ash? ash (product): Reviewing notes now. Webinar campaign: use existing SFDC `Launch-Q2-2026`. I will map signups to marketing@redwood.ai via webhook.

lee (docs): Docs URLs: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started and https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-q2-2026. I added a short quantized example. Will grab the dashboard screenshot after smoke and redact.

maria (marketing): Bench numbers needed for the blog (median/p95 + cost). Small one-liner blurb is fine.

dev (eng): Bench (dedicated): median 45ms/token, p95 200ms/token, cost ~ $0.0020 per 1k tokens. CSV: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-q2-2026.csv

oliver (ops): Canary plan: smoke 09:30 PT @5% for 10m, ramp 09:45 PT @30% for 20m, full at 10:15 PT. Rollback triggers: error-rate >0.8% for 5m or p95 >700ms for 3 consecutive 60s windows. I'll own watch and enable deploy-bot rollback hook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 1789999800. Image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-q2-canary. Logs: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1789999800

maria (marketing): Perfect — final checklist: changelog (dev) ✅, docs + screenshot (lee) pending, bench blurb (dev) ✅, canary timing & ops (oliver) ✅, webinar routing (ash) ✅. If all green, blog scheduled 11:00 PT with links + bench table + CTA. Post any last-minute blockers here or DM me. :rocket:
